Stretching guidance · Mayo Clinic ↗

Check with your obstetrician or midwife and get approval for your exercise plan first. Choose movements and adjustments that suit your pregnancy.

Keep a moderate pace where you can talk. Stay comfortable, hydrated and cool.

Guidance: ACOG ↗ · NHS ↗
When to stop and contact your maternity team

Stop exercising and contact your maternity team promptly for any of these symptoms:

  • Vaginal bleeding or fluid leaking
  • Dizziness, fainting, headache or muscle weakness
  • Chest pain or breathlessness before exercise
  • Calf pain or swelling
  • Regular, painful contractions
